subject: Security due diligence: identity controls and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@careprime.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security due diligence: identity controls and next steps

Hi Evan / Sally,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — really appreciated the open discussion about your HIPAA scoping and how CarePrime plans to authenticate provider staff. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the identity & access items you asked us to confirm and outline next steps.

Quick recap
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; summary PDF attached and I can share the full report via an NDA if you prefer.
- SSO / SAML: We support SAML 2.0 IdP integrations and have a guided SSO runbook for Azure AD, Okta, and OneLogin.
- SCIM provisioning: SCIM v2 supported for group and user provisioning; delta syncs and soft-deletes available.
- RBAC / admin controls: Role-based admin console with organization-level owners, scoped model access, and MFA enforcement.

Actions you requested
1) Evidence pack showing SSO config steps + SCIM schema — Ben to deliver (attachment: id-access-matrix.xlsx and sso-scim-diagram.png).
2) Short answers to three security questionnaire items (SOC 2, data residency, admin change logs) — Marissa to follow up.
3) Procure step for contractual security addendum / DPA — Monica leading procurement thread.

Next steps / owners
- Ben: Attach the ID access matrix and the SSO/SCIM diagram for your security team to review (attached).
- Marissa: Follow up with short-form answers to your questionnaire and point to the SOC 2 evidence we can provide under an NDA.
- Monica: I’ll introduce you to Monica separately for procurement and DPA timing.

If you can confirm the best place to upload the evidence (secure SFTP / shared Drive / HubSpot secure link), we’ll prepare the bundle and target delivery by Wednesday (10/28).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

[Attachments: id-access-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB), sso-scim-diagram.png (png, 85KB), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@careprime.health>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:03:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Security due diligence: identity controls and next steps

Hi team / Evan — thanks for the clear asks. Below are concise answers we can share with CarePrime. I’ve attached the SOC 2 summary and a brief CSV-style attribute map in the Drive folder link (shared).

Short-form answers
- SOC 2 scope: Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II (2025-10 to 2026-09) includes our hosted US regions, including us-west-2. We encrypt persisted KV and token caches using AES-256 with customer-seeded keys at rest; keys are managed in our KMS with rotation policies. Full report is available under NDA.

- SCIM attribute map (high level):
  - external_group_id -> id
  - userName -> userName (email)
  - displayName -> name.formatted
  - manager -> manager.value (supports manager lookup by UUID/email)
  - active -> active (boolean)

Example PATCH (snippet):
  PATCH /scim/v2/Users/12345
  Content-Type: application/scim+json
  {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"Replace","path":"name.familyName","value":"Nguyen"}]}

- RBAC / audit exports: Admin role changes are recorded in our audit log stream; exports can be generated for arbitrary windows (CSV) and retained default 13 months. Retention can be extended via enterprise add-on.

Deliverables we will upload to your Drive (by 10/28):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary, public)
- id-access-matrix.xlsx (SSO/SCIM mapping + recommended config steps)
- sso-scim-diagram.png (network flow + example requests)
- sample-scim-requests.txt (example POST/PATCH payloads)

If Evan / Sally want the SOC 2 full report, we’ll need a signed NDA or existing PCA (please advise preferred intake method). Monica — happy to coordinate procurement once Evan confirms the DPA path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
